title: Sand-dune migration east of the Al-Ahsa oasis near the Salwa to Al Hofuf road: 2017 to 2026

headline.label: median dune migration towards the south, 171 of 357 chips moving

service.name: Sand Dune Encroachment Monitoring for Roads and Facilities

data: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance, 10 m, tile 39RUH, relative orbit 106: scene S2A_39RUH_20170130_0_L2A (30 January 2017, tile cloud 0.12%) and scene S2C_39RUH_20260202_0_L2A (2 February 2026, tile cloud 0.005%), read as 15 × 15 km windows of cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs through the Earth Search STAC API (Element 84, collection sentinel-2-l2a).
method: Two scenes on the same orbit in the same season, 9.0 years apart, and a 15 × 15 km window (EPSG:32639) holding dunes, a highway and the edge of farms.
Cut the red band into 841 chips of 640 m every 500 m and found each chip's shift between the dates by phase correlation to a tenth of a pixel.
Corrected the misregistration between the scenes from a stable area of farms and buildings: 0.3 and 0.1 pixels, about 3 m, subtracted from every chip.
Kept a chip when its texture was sufficient, its correlation after alignment was 0.5 or more and its shift was under 300 m: 357 chips.
limits: A chip vector is the average movement of the dune pattern over 640 m, not the path of one dune, and dunes that change shape, merge or move more than 300 m are missed. The detection limit is about 2.2 m per year and the corrected misregistration about 3 m. The result was not checked in the field or on finer imagery.
